newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank raises size of offshore loans.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank raises size of offshore loans.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Friday it would raise the minimum level of offshore loans brought in by domestic borrowers through the Bangkok International Banking Facility to $5 million from $2 million.
The move would take effect next month, the central bank governor Rerngchai Marakanond told reporters.

The new BOT measure is part of an attempt to curb short-term foreign inflows into Thailand, the governor said. The move would restrain small borrowers and would make it more costly to borrow funds from abraod.
"The BOT new measure will be aimed at ensuring that foreign funds flowing through the BIBF is long-term money and really used for investments," he said.
